scope: Users can configure saved-search title and keyword filters, preview captured versus prefiltered/rejected/deferred source rows, persist criteria to the profile-scoped search, and apply those saved criteria in the discovery worker before deterministic scoring. Source postings remain durably stored; uncertain/oversized rows are not falsely rejected, candidates beyond the cap are deferred, and preview errors preserve criteria and posting history.

environment.database: temporary SQLite fixtures with explicit selected source and saved-search profile
environment.browser: local connected Chromium; cross-origin requests blocked
environment.frontend: local focused Vitest and TypeScript/Vite production build
environment.delivery: local-only; hosted automation/review disabled; external application submission OFF

limitations: The filter caps current scoring candidates at 500 and explicitly defers remaining plausible rows; this is bounded staged scoring, not proof that every collected posting is scored immediately.
The app has no configured AI enrichment step in this workflow; this filter prevents unnecessary deterministic scoring and does not claim AI analysis savings.
Release readiness remains UNKNOWN; issue scope completion is not whole-product completion.
safety: Preview reads explicitly selected source IDs and saved-search profile scope; cross-profile and missing-source requests fail closed.
Captured postings are not deleted by reject/defer outcomes or preview errors.
